subject: Plantin Tech onboarding: PO setup, invoice cadence, and optional early-pay path
messages:
From: Sara Goldstein <sara.goldstein@plantintech.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: accounts@plantintech.com
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding: Plantin Tech — payment terms and early-pay option

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. We're excited to start supporting Redwood with the integration work and wanted to get the vendor onboarding paperwork moving. Attached are: Plantin_Onboarding_Form.pdf, our W-9, and a sample invoice.

A few items for your team to review:
- Preferred payment terms: Net 30 (our standard).
- We'd like to enroll in any early-pay/discount program you offer — we can accept Net15 at a small discount (1.25% fee) if that helps cash flow.
- PO and invoice requirements: please confirm the PO reference placement and whether we should include the Redwood project code in the invoice line.

Let me know the next steps (portal upload, DocuSign vendor agreement, or PO acceptance).

Thanks,
Sara Goldstein
Finance Lead | Plantin Tech
attachments: plantin_onboarding_form.pdf; plantin_w9.pdf; sample-invoice.xlsx

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Sara Goldstein <sara.goldstein@plantintech.com>
Cc: david_kim@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: Plantin Tech — payment terms and early-pay option

Sara — thanks for sending these over and the quick turnaround. Looping in David (Procurement) and Monica (Finance ops) to get the onboarding and PO path stood up.

Quick notes and asks so we can move straight to PO issuance:
- We usually issue POs under standard Net45 for new vendors while we complete the intake checklist. Would you be able to accept Net45 on the first 2 invoices while onboarding completes? After intake we can consider Net30 for ongoing cadence.
- For early pay: we run a dynamic discount program (vendor portal). Typical pilot fee is between 0.75%–1.25% depending on volume/tenor. If you want Net15, we can surface the exact rate from Finance ops.
- AP header: please ensure invoices include the PO number and the Redwood project code in the top-right. We also need the remittance bank details to match the W-9 attachment.
- Next steps: Monica will send the DocuSign vendor agreement + a vendor portal invite link. Please upload the onboarding form there and attach the same sample invoice format.

I'll put this on a short internal sprint to get the PO out once David confirms the routing. Thanks again — excited to work together.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
attachments: none

From: david_kim@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, Sara Goldstein <sara.goldstein@plantintech.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Vendor onboarding: Plantin Tech — payment terms and early-pay option

Marissa / Sara — thanks. A couple of procurement-specific items so we can finalize PO cadence and issue: 

1) We can provisionally issue a PO on Net45 for the first two invoices to account for intake checks (tax validation, insurance certs, PO matching). After successful intake, we will move to Net30 as requested by Plantin.
2) Early-pay: we can onboard Plantin into Redwood's EarlyPay offering. For an initial pilot, Finance is proposing a 0.85% discount for Net15 settlement. If you accept, we will enable the dynamic discounting flag on the PO and provide an early-pay URL where you can opt in per-invoice.
3) Invoicing requirements (please follow exactly):
   - Invoice must reference PO#: RW-2027-PL-XXXX in the header.
   - One invoice per PO line item; combined service lines allowed if clearly described.
   - Send PDFs to AP@redwood.com and upload to the vendor portal.
4) Banking: We need the bank routing details to be sent via our secure vendor portal (do not reply-all with full bank account details).

Sara — if you confirm acceptance of Net45 first-two-invoices and participation in EarlyPay at 0.85%, I will create the PO and route it for signature. Also attaching a checklist (inline) for onboarding:
- Completed onboarding form (received)
- W-9 (received)
- Sample invoice (received)
- Insurance certificate (pending)
- Bank details (via portal)

Please confirm and we'll move quickly.

Thanks,
David Kim
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Sara Goldstein <sara.goldstein@plantintech.com>
To: david_kim@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: accounts@plantintech.com
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: Plantin Tech — payment terms and early-pay option

David / Marissa — confirmed. Plantin accepts: 
- Provisional Net45 for the first two invoices while onboarding completes.
- Enrollment in Redwood EarlyPay at the proposed 0.85% discount for Net15. We'll opt-in per-invoice via the early-pay link.

Next steps for us:
- Monica: please send the DocuSign vendor agreement and the secure vendor portal link for bank details.
- Accounts: we'll upload the bank info to the portal and re-upload the W-9 to ensure matching metadata.

Appreciate the flexibility, and we'll stand by to sign the PO once issued.

Best,
Sara
Finance Lead | Plantin Tech
